Subject: Sponsor presence — late window / priority demo for BlueCrest Analytics

Hi Aiden,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. BlueCrest's use case (real-time embeddings for analyst workflows) aligns well with a short executive walkthrough + a technical demo.

Ask: can we lock a 45-minute demo that includes your CIO or VP of Data? We find having an exec sponsor for the first live run helps speed procurement and pilot approvals.

Our team is available for a late-window slot the week of Jan 10–14; suggested times (PT):
- Tue Jan 12, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Jan 13, 15:00–15:45
- Thu Jan 14, 08:30–09:15

If none of those work, send a couple windows that do and we’ll try to accommodate. Agenda draft attached (short deck + success criteria checklist).

We can tailor the demo: Rafael will lead the exec intro and value discussion; Priyom will present the architecture and latency/cost details. If your VP can only join briefly, we’ll make sure the key asks are front-loaded.

Thanks — look forward to locking something.

—
Rafael Mendes
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0192

If you can hold Jan 12 10:00 PT, we’ll confirm on our side. Also, can you share whether you can cover a short procurement/units estimate in the meeting? Our procurement folks want a ballpark prior to booking the pilot engagement.
